items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Ma come down to my brother's house. 'Mr. Tom, Mr. Tom, a man pulled my gold pieces off my -- and almost broke my ligaments.'

ctx.x: Ma had (unintelligible). My brother took Ma and Ma had had a chain around her neck. It had (unintelligible) a 25 gold piece. So somebody comes down Chicago and he snatched them things off of old Ma's neck. Ma come down to my brother's house. "Mr. Tom, Mr. Tom, a man pulled my gold pieces off my -- and almost broke my ligaments." And my brother's standing there, the way he talked, he said, "Well, (unintelligible) Ma. Why would you want to a lot of money on your neck?" And (unintelligible) that's what my brother…
Did she still do it after the man pulled them off?
